summary: Reproduced the ModelOpt NVFP4 MoE apply-dispatch contradiction with a cached FLASHINFER_CUTLASS layer backend and live TRITON/AUTO global state. Inspected open upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38932, then implemented the requested mirror fix with regression coverage and preserved the existing routed TRT-LLM behavior. Changed the TRT-LLM, CuTeDSL, and CUTLASS apply guards to use the same authoritative per-layer backend already used by the other branches and diagnostics. Regression tests exercise adaptive-style target/draft state transitions, every supported local apply branch, and missing cached state while stopping external kernels at the runner boundary.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction through the actual ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod.apply dispatch: cached FLASHINFER_CUTLASS with live TRITON/AUTO raised the contradictory NotImplementedError. Raw output: /job/raw-output/failing-before.txt

103 tests and 140 subtests passed. Covered cached CUTLASS under live TRITON/AUTO, cached unsupported TRITON under live CUTLASS, absent cached state, and CUTLASS/TRT-LLM/CuTeDSL/MegaMoE/Marlin local apply branches. External fused kernels were intercepted at runner.run. Raw output: /job/raw-output/passing-after.txt
Patch whitespace validity and Python syntax compilation.
Lint tool availability; the prepared interpreter has no ruff module. Raw output: /job/raw-output/ruff.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: Prepared interpreter reports torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, CUDA runtime null, and one ROCm-visible device. No CUDA/Blackwell kernel was executed because the issue requires CUDA NVFP4 on B300; this dispatch-only change does not alter numerical kernels.
remaining_limitations: The reported 8xB300 sm_103 adaptive EAGLE startup and CUDA-graph capture remain explicitly unverified because the assigned environment is a single ROCm device with no CUDA runtime.
No GPU numerical comparison was performed: the patch changes only backend branch selection and calls the existing runner unchanged; external kernels were instrumented only at runner.run.
No native code changed and repository-environment.json provides no native rebuild target.
Ruff was unavailable in the prepared Python environment.
